content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will meet in a Regular Meeting on Wednesday, August 4, 2021 at the District Office Board Room (21920 SW Sherwood Blvd). *This will be an in-person public meeting.

  • 7:00 pm – Regular Meeting (District Office Board Room)

The agenda for this meeting can be viewed here.

In-person attendance is now available at all public meetings. Public comment for this meeting can be provided via in-person attendance or via online submission. To sign up for in-person public comment, up to three minutes in length, please arrive prior to the meeting start time and sign up via the sign up sheet on the table just inside the door of our Board Room.

To electronically submit written public comment during our Board of Directors Meeting, please complete the form here.  Public comment will be accepted through this agenda item on Wednesday, August 4, 2021.  During the meeting, all electronically submitted public comment will be read aloud by the Board Secretary, up to three minutes in length per comment (as per time limit indicated on the meeting agenda).  Please note that members of the public may submit their comments in-person OR via online submission, but not both. Written comments submitted by those who have already spoken in person during the meeting will not be read aloud.

The purpose of public comment is for members of our Board of Directors to hear public concerns, comments, and opinions.  Board members will not respond to submitted public comment.

 To view video of this meeting, please visit the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3
